title: lennrt/palomar-formalizations
abstract: A Lean formalization of Lemma 7.1 and the outer-matrix content of Theorem 7.2 for generalized cubic subdivision. It defines the naturally indexed 28n by 28n outer matrix row-by-row from the authenticated released MATLAB masks, including all previous/current/next-sector references. It constructs the paper's explicit topological permutation, proves that the first 24n coordinates are strictly upper triangular and that the remaining diagonal components are n scalar 1/64 blocks and n copies of the displayed 3 by 3 core, and proves unconditionally for every n at least 3 the characteristic polynomial X^(24n)(X-1/64)^n(X-1/32)^n(X-1/16)^n(X-1/8)^n.
